summary: Iteration 4 — Badminton Academy Manager full regression after GitHub commit 0a69963 (autopay + waitlist + Stripe hardening). 31 pytest cases run against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://squad-flow.preview.emergentagent.com: 29 PASS, 2 SKIPPED (no eligible seeded data: no pending parent payment for Stripe-checkout creation; no eligible enrollment without existing subscription for autopay creation). Zero failures. Verified: (1) all 3 role logins + /auth/me + /auth/refresh; brute-force lockout still kicks in at attempt 5 (429/423 returned). (2) Sessions CRUD lifecycle (create→patch→get→delete). (3) Payments list + /payments/generate-monthly idempotent for 2099-01. (4) Stripe /billing/config returns stripe_configured=true; /billing/checkout-status/{unknown} returns 404; previously HIGH-priority 500 bug from iter3 is FIXED — checkout_status now wraps the Stripe lookup in try/except and falls back to local payment_transactions state (lines 399-430 of billing_routes.py). (5) Coach payslip works on /api/coach-payouts/{coach_id}/payslip for both basis=expected and basis=collected. (6) Expenses CRUD. (7) NEW Waitlist endpoints: admin list, parent scoped list, POST /waitlist creates entry, admin can enroll/promote. (8) NEW Autopay: /billing/subscription-checkout validation (400 on bad id) and customer-portal (400 without customer) work. (9) Settings GET/PATCH on academy 'name' persist correctly. (10) Admin/coach/parent dashboards aggregate cleanly. (11) /messages/contacts works for admin & parent. Frontend smoke (all 3 roles, 14 screens) — every page loads with zero console errors. Parent Payments page renders auto-pay section with Set up / Pause buttons + Stripe helper text. Admin Waitlist page renders entries with Enroll action.

minor.issue: Requires full SessionIn body (all fields). Sending {monthly_price: 120} returns 422. Not true PATCH semantics — should accept partial updates. UI works because it submits the full session object.
Requires full ExpenseIn body. Sending {amount: 22} returns 422. Same partial-update concern as sessions.
No cleanup of soft-deleted/leftover TEST_iter4 entries. Two TEST_iter4_* waitlist entries created during this run are still visible on /admin/waitlist.

issues: Renders correctly with student/session/parent/status/requested/action columns and Enroll button. Test waitlist entries from regression visible — admin should manually clean or backend should support soft-delete/expire.
Auto-pay section renders with per-enrollment Set up + Pause buttons, monthly amount, and 'Pay by card (Stripe)' helper text. Looks correct.

action_items: LOW: Make PATCH /sessions/{sid} and PATCH /expenses/{eid} accept partial updates by introducing SessionUpdateIn / ExpenseUpdateIn with all Optional fields. Current behavior is functional via UI (full payload) but breaks REST PATCH semantics and hampers API consumers.
LOW: Add admin endpoint to remove/expire waitlist entries (soft delete). The waitlist_routes.py has is_deleted filter on list but no DELETE endpoint exposed.

LOW: Optional seed data — give parent@badminton.app at least one pending payment (so Stripe checkout creation is exercisable end-to-end) and at least one eligible enrollment without a subscription (so /billing/subscription-checkout is exercisable). Currently both code paths are reachable only via manual setup.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_routes.checkout_status — iter3 HIGH bug is FIXED. The try/except block (lines 399-430) properly falls back to local payment_transactions state when stripe.Session.retrieve fails, avoiding the emergentintegrations pydantic StripeObject->dict validation issue. Good fix.
billing_routes._return_origin — properly validates origin against FRONTEND_URL/CORS_ORIGINS allowlist. Will return 400 if frontend on a different preview host attempts checkout. Worth documenting.

billing_routes.stripe_webhook — handles checkout.session.completed, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted. Idempotent payments insert via existing-period lookup before insert. Good.
waitlist_routes.create_waitlist_entry uses EnrollmentIn payload — semantically weird (it's a waitlist join, not an enrollment); a dedicated WaitlistJoinIn model would be cleaner.

settings_routes — singleton academy_settings has no `payout_basis` field; payout basis is per-coach in payout_rules. Documentation/iter3 report mentioned a global payout_basis on /api/settings but it's actually only via /api/settings/payout-basis (per coach).
PATCH endpoints (sessions, expenses) require full Pydantic body — see action_items. Not a regression but a long-standing design quirk.
_apply_paid in billing_routes — uses MongoDB update_one with set fields; safely idempotent (early return when status==paid). Good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 PASS, 2 skipped due to no eligible seed data)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — 14/14 screens loaded, 0 console errors across admin/coach/parent roles

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_iter4_* waitlist entries (one of which references TEST_iter4 session id; the other a real session). One TEST_iter4 session was created and soft-deleted within the lifecycle test. One TEST_iter4 expense created and soft-deleted. Two waitlist entries persist — recommend manual cleanup or expose a DELETE /waitlist/{id} endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter3 HIGH Stripe-polling 500 is FIXED. All new commit 0a69963 endpoints (waitlist + autopay/subscription-checkout + customer-portal) are reachable and validate correctly. Two skipped tests can be lit up by seeding pending payments and a no-subscription enrollment for parent@badminton.app. The TEST_iter4 waitlist leftovers + iter3's 'BLno Test' settings name should be cleaned. iter4_test.py is idempotent and re-runnable.
rca_of_the_issue: No critical bugs found. Previous iter3 HIGH-priority Stripe checkout-status 500 was resolved by E1 by wrapping sc.get_checkout_status / stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve in try/except and falling back to local payment_transactions DB state (lines 399-430 billing_routes.py). Verified via test_checkout_status_unknown_session (correctly 404) and successful billing_config + autopay validation tests. Polling now degrades gracefully even if Stripe SDK errors.
